title: Zenith Comforting Irish Potato Stew
description: A hearty and comforting Irish stew featuring charred potatoes and cardamom, made in a wok and perfect for a cold evening, this dish is also buddhist-temple-friendly as it is vegetarian and does not contain any animal products.
instructions: Heat the wok over high heat and add the olive oil to coat the bottom.
Add the chopped onions to the wok and cook until they are lightly charred, stirring occasionally.
Add the cubed potatoes and sliced carrots to the wok and continue to cook until they are lightly charred, stirring occasionally.
Add the ground cardamom to the wok and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Pour in the low sodium vegetable broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the stew for 20 minutes, or until the potatoes and carrots are tender.
Use the deglazing technique to scrape up any browned bits from the bottom of the wok.
Season the stew with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
